cd /workspace && python3 - <<'EOF'
p='tests/test_qp.py'
lines=open(p).read().split('\n')
out=[]
inmain=False
for ln in lines:
    if ln.startswith('def main():'):
        inmain=True; out.append(ln); continue
    if ln.startswith('if __name__'):
        inmain=False; out.append(ln); continue
    if inmain and ln.strip():
        out.append('    '+ln.lstrip())
    else:
        out.append(ln)
open(p,'w').write('\n'.join(out))
EOF
